cards.english: The bus stop is around the corner.
He has been sitting here for a long time.
She has tied up the boat.
Tell me if you need help.
The platform is down on the right.

cards.target: Jag har hört talas om det.
Han undrade vem som hade ringt.
Det är bra att du berättade.
cards.english: It's good that you told me.

cards.target: Tack så jättemycket varje dag egentligen!
cards.english: Thanks so much every day actually!

cards.target: Hon har burit väskan hela dagen.
cards.english: She has carried the bag all day.

cards.target: Vi äter när maten är klar.
cards.english: We eat when the food is ready.

cards.target: Bensinstationen ligger vid avfarten från motorvägen.
cards.english: The gas station is located at the highway exit.

cards.target: Det tar ungefär en timme med bil.
cards.english: It takes about an hour by car.

cards.target: Man aldrig vet om det kan hända.
cards.english: You never know if it can happen.

cards.target: Jag vill bara säga förra veckan verkligen.
cards.english: I just want to say last week really.

cards.target: Vi ber er notera väldigt ofta här.
cards.english: We ask you to note very often here.

cards.target: Om jag hade vetat hade jag kommit.
cards.english: If I had known I would have come.

cards.target: Innan du går, kan du stänga fönstret?
cards.english: Before you go, can you close the window?

cards.target: Vi tog andra platsen på kvällen verkligen.
cards.english: We took second place in the evening really.

cards.target: De ville veta om vi behövde hjälp.
cards.english: They wanted to know if we needed help.

cards.target: Maten var jättegod i centrum ibland redan!
cards.english: The food was really delicious in the center sometimes already!

cards.target: Nu när du är här kan vi börja.
cards.english: Now that you're here we can start.

cards.target: Vi vet inte hur lång tid det tar.
cards.english: We don't know how long it takes.

cards.target: Innan vi åker måste vi handla med familjen.
cards.english: Before we leave we need to go shopping with the family.

cards.target: Jag saknar mina vänner i Stockholm väldigt mycket nu.
cards.english: I miss my friends in Stockholm very much.

cards.target: Tack för att du kom med så kort varsel.
cards.english: Thank you for coming on such short notice.

cards.target: Förlåt att jag är sen, trafiken var helt fruktansvärd.
cards.english: Sorry I am late, the traffic was absolutely terrible.

cards.target: Vi har redan bestämt oss för resemålet nästa sommar.
cards.english: We have already decided on the travel destination for next summer.

cards.target: Vi har inte setts på väldigt länge nu tyvärr.
cards.english: We have not seen each other for a very long time unfortunately.

cards.target: Hon har vunnit tävlingen två gånger redan det här året.
cards.english: She has won the competition twice already this year.

cards.target: Jag har nyss flyttat hit från ett annat land nyligen.
cards.english: I have just moved here from another country.

cards.target: Han har arbetat övertid hela månaden för att hinna klart.
cards.english: He has worked overtime all month to finish on time.

cards.target: Det var verkligen trevligt att prata med dig idag igen.
cards.english: It was really nice to talk with you today again.

cards.target: Kan du ge dem beskedet innan du går hem idag?
cards.english: Can you give them the message before you go home today?

cards.target: De har umgåtts med sina grannar varje helg sedan inflyttningen.
cards.english: They have socialized with their neighbors every weekend since moving in.

cards.target: Vi har skrivit klart rapporten och skickat den till chefen.
cards.english: We have finished writing the report and sent it to the boss.

cards.target: Det var den bästa filmen jag har sett på väldigt länge.
cards.english: It was the best movie I have seen in a very long time.

cards.target: Jag har bott i Stockholm i fem år och trivs jättebra.
cards.english: I have lived in Stockholm for five years and enjoy it very much.

cards.target: Okej, lyssna nu, jag har några viktiga nyheter att dela med alla.
cards.english: Okay, listen now, I have some important news to share with everyone.
We drive on the motorway northbound.

existing_tips: Days of the week are not capitalized in Swedish.
"Det finns" (there is/are) works for both singular and plural in Swedish.
"För att" = because (reason). Not to be confused with "för att" = in order to (purpose).
"Om" = if/whether in subordinate clauses. Different from "om" = about.
Simple definite: "Huset" = the house. Suffix -et for ett-words.
'Sedan' (then/since) – dual meaning: 'sedan igår' (since yesterday), 'sedan gick vi' (then we left).
